question: Which identity can cut a Release and move a channel tag under a tag ruleset, from a workflow in the Factory repo?
pass: One identity, through one path (section 6). As the story, #189, states it, under the Factory Builder's ruling of 2026-11-09, pre-approved by the Maintainer on 2026-11-08: from release.yml on main, one identity created the immutable tag factory/v0.1.0 and moved the channel tag factory/v0-next to it, in run 42348605675, and the Deployment of factory-next that the same step recorded names that identity as its creator; a second cut of the same Release, run 42348650504, wrote nothing; the tag ruleset factory release tags (25183656), which refuses creating, updating, deleting or force-pushing any refs/tags/factory/* tag, names in its bypass list that identity and the admin role alone, the admin role being the Maintainer's own login (recovery, section 9.1); and the ruleset factory releases are immutable (25996980) lets no one move or delete a Release tag. The live read of 25183656's bypass list stands in for each other identity's refusal, the machine user's and each other Factory App's: an identity the list does not name is refused by the ruleset. Residual, stated: no other identity's refusal was exercised. The identity is the App combsmith-sf-release, 5502359 (decision 0114). The poller's job token was not taken: GitHub grants a job token no workflows permission, which a tag on a commit that touches .github/workflows/ needs (decision 0114), and a bypass for it would name GitHub Actions, through which every workflow of this repo would pass the ruleset, not one path.

head_commit.message:
The artifact storage is any productionresults account numbered in one to three digits (record 0151) (#598)

* The artifact storage is any productionresults account numbered in one to three digits (record NNNN)

The cut of factory/v0.1.0 was refused with eval_gate_closed: the eval
report's download redirected to productionresultssa32, which the
transport's STORAGE pattern, sa0 to sa19 by decision 0045, refused, so
the report was read as unanswered. By the Maintainer's ruling, the
storage is productionresultssa and one to three digits, with no leading
zero; the rest of 0045's row stands.

- STORAGE in adapters/github.py widened, and a boundary test: sa0 to
  sa999 accepted; sa1000, a leading zero, a letter or non-ASCII digit
  in the number, another account name and another host refused.
- Mutants: a fourth digit, a stop at sa99 or sa19, a leading zero, a
  trailing letter, Unicode digits, and any account name.
- Record NNNN replaces 0147, the one record in force of those that hold
  0045's rows (0045, then 0138, then 0147), and overturns only the
  accounts 0045's row names. 0147's Status says it is replaced.

Every artifact read through the redirect, a Run's outcome, a Lens's
applied/1, the pass records and the eval report, had the same latent
failure whenever GitHub served it past sa19.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix round 1 on record 0151: no mutant that no test can kill, and the record named

- The mutant giving the storage's number any Unicode digit is dropped:
  storage() refuses a URL that is not ASCII before STORAGE is read, so
  no test can tell it from the code. The record's row no longer claims
  it (the security pass, the Claude review, Astra and Argon).
- The record says that every account from sa0 to sa999 being GitHub's
  is assumed, not known, and what the ruling accepts in it (the
  security pass).
- The record says a leading zero is refused, narrower than the ruling,
  since GitHub's names have none (the Factory Builder).
- NNNN is 0151, the Factory Builder's number, everywhere (Argon).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
